opaque_region.definition: A visibly bounded or candidate-envelope region in which separate internal routes cannot be traced. Store region/envelope alternatives and visible boundary ports; no hidden skeleton, biological organ label or forced main axis.
opaque_region.not_required: Exact segmentation, complete boundary pixel mask, internal routing or finite count of invisible subparts.

port.definition: Coordinate-supported place where one visible passage meets a region, end-zone or visible joining area. A port is an incidence observation, not proof that all ports on a broad region meet internally.
port.evidence: Source coordinate interval/box, incident passage ID, continuous/contact/overlap status and view receipt.

carrier.definition: A separately traceable nonbranching passage between a body/join port and a distal end-zone. Roles are local incidence roles, not thickness classes or leaf/root/stem assignments. A bare terminal passage is allowed as a carrier with a bare end-zone. Two-end orientation is fixed only by observed body/join versus end-zone relation; if both directions or different levels are plausible retain alternatives.
carrier.evidence: Original-coordinate polyline plus two separated transverse boundary witness segments or explicit single-stroke evidence. No split at colour/width change alone.

end_zone.definition: A local distal cap or first visibly delimited attachment/fan region reached along that carrier. It may be a free cap or support directly outgoing channels; it is not automatically a free terminal. An arbitrary cut through a uniform passage is not a new end-zone.
end_zone.boundary_rule: Give the cap/transition/first local branching evidence that distinguishes this zone; if more than one grouping is plausible retain all supported candidates. Unbounded ambiguity is recorded as unresolved, not forced into one zone.

direct_child_channel.definition: A separately witnessed passage from a port of the end-zone to a visible free end, without an intervening visible branch or another unresolved region. Fine means direct child at this local level, not a numerical width cutoff. Passages that branch or disappear before a free end remain unresolved for this child category.
direct_child_channel.evidence: Own free-end box, whole visible path and two transverse boundary witnesses or single-stroke record. Each physical trace ID once; shared tail belongs to one shared edge.

visible_join.definition: One local visible junction with at least three separate channel arms and actual continuity witnesses; outlined edges do not count as separate arms. A broad region with several ports is not a join unless a bounded local junction is independently visible.

representation.non_requirement: This incidence table may be disconnected and can have alternative parents or overlaps. It is not a required full tree or a biological hierarchy. A region may have higher-level and lower-level roles only with separately witnessed incidences; no recursive hidden branching is inferred.

coordinates.motif: Distinct carrier-end-zone units with exactly zero direct free-ending child channels. Local end-zone perimeter/attachments must be sufficiently inspected to rule out a child; not merely no child recorded.
Distinct carrier-end-zone units with exactly one direct free-ending child channel. One positive witness plus local coverage ruling out a second; one witnessed child alone is not enough.
Distinct carrier-end-zone units with at least two mutually compatible, distinct direct free-ending child channels. Two suffice even if more children remain unresolved.
Distinct locally visible joining regions with at least three independent continuous arms; broad body ports alone excluded.

signature.meaning: z_k=min(N_k,2); state2 means two-or-more, not exactlytwo. Threshold2 is a fixed saturation level, not an observed feature-tuning parameter. All four coordinates have equal primary weight.
signature.why_finite: Each entry has at most3^4=81 capped signatures even when whole-entry raw totals have no finite upper bound. Unknown raw total is not treated as infinity or a known number.
signature.positive_witness_rule: Two compatible distinct motifs of one class certify state2 without a complete entry inventory. One certifies only lower bound1 unless additional instances are ruled out. Zero requires complete relevant search/coverage for that class.
signature.residual_rule: If an unreviewed or unresolved region could contain more motifs of classk, retain the possible higher capped states. A completely unresolved coordinate remains{0,1,2}. ClassQ0/Q1 lower witnesses require their local absence/uniqueness condition independently of global coverage.
signature.non_independence: Q0/Q1/Q2 for the same carrier-end-zone unit are mutually exclusive. A junction and a carrier-end-zone may involve shared material, so coordinate dimensions are not independent measurements.

dependencies.canonical_ids: Reuse a canonical physical trace/zone/port ID in all references and pairs. Distinct record IDs do not alone prove distinct structures.
constraints: Alternative same/duplicate IDs merge before counts.
A child belongs to its selected zone/port in one complete interpretation; do not give it to both alternatives.
Shared tails and candidate equivalent zones cannot each raise lower counts.
One carrier-end-zone contributes to exactly one ofQ0/Q1/Q2 when its child count category is established.
If a local role/orientation is ambiguous, choose one full supported alternative for all four coordinates and all pair comparisons.
dependencies.admissible_entry_set: Represent A_i subset of{0,1,2}^4 from all admissible complete local interpretations plus explicit residual uncertainty. Keep witness/constraint references for each signature or each restriction. Preserve disjunctions; do not independently project and recombine coordinates as if all combinations were proven feasible.
dependencies.safe_relaxation: If residual structure cannot be fully enumerated, a documented superset of capped signatures may be used for conservative outer bounds. Retain every known alias/exclusion/ownership constraint; do not mark these outer witnesses as jointly realizable drawings. An empty set is an input conflict and stops calculation, never recoded unknown.
dependencies.no_candidate_cherry_pick: A whole entry signature/interpretation is fixed across all its incident pairs. No independent pairwise best graph match; no feature-specific best local partition.

primary_quantity.contrast: H_b=(1/|M_b|) sum_{s in M_b}[mean_{(i,j) in P_s,b}S(i,j)-mean_{(i,j) in N_s,b}S(i,j)], where s is a fixed cross-manuscript source-pair stratum and M_b contains strata with both classes under frozen naming branchb.

primary_quantity.naming_and_pair_freeze: Use fixed_naming_branches and all15 roles specified here from frozen source_qualification_v1 and its wording correction. Freeze before new coding. Report primary conditional H, undefined strict branch, and prespecified matched-four sensitivity without selecting by sign.
primary_quantity.source_dependence: Same-manuscript or same-source-image pairs are descriptive only. If two entries reuse the same physical drawing, share its canonical state; do not count duplicate references as independent source evidence. Physical-leaf aliases retained.
primary_quantity.undefined: If no mixed eligible cross-manuscript stratum exists, H_b=null. Undefined source unit blocks that unit-level score; do not delete the unit to rescue a full-six claim. All six record rows and all15 pair roles remain reported.
primary_quantity.bounds: For each frozen name branch and full admissible candidate interpretation, optimize the entire H_b jointly over all entry signatures with sharing; then envelope over admissible complete candidates. Keep lower/upper witness signatures, per-feature and per-stratum contributions, pair denominators, candidate IDs and residual-superset status. Pairwise extrema are not aggregated as jointly attainable.
primary_quantity.computational_note: Use finite signature sets plus exact enumeration/variable elimination or a verified global optimization. In a bipartite two-manuscript graph, enumerate one side and optimize each opposite entry conditional on it; preserve each entry full4-coordinate signature. No per-coordinate separability assumption. If a resource budget is exceeded, report computation unresolved or proved conservative bounds, never heuristic extrema as exact. For the conditional5-entry primary, enumerate the two Morgan full signatures (at most81^2); conditionally optimize each of the three Ashmole full signatures. F02 has zero contrast weight but remains in allpair/unknown reports. This respects entire-entry constraints without81^5 brute force.
primary_quantity.interpretation: Finite drawing-annotation similarity, not name recognition accuracy, species identity or semantics. Shared absences can raise similarity; show per-coordinate contributions and no-information constant-coordinate cases. G1-G4 remain a separately labeled unchanged baseline.

gate.one_revision: One explicit development revision cycle on fixed K01-K04 only. This proposal is its candidate text. A bounded four-entry operational pass may expose one final written revision; preserve proposal, observations and old failure, rerun/check allfour consistently if definitions change, then freeze. No repeated threshold search or selecting a version for name-score sign.
gate.development_scores: No K01-K04 same-name score is required for choosing/fixing definitions. Feasibility means local witness/coverage/candidate rules can be used uniformly, not that similar names produce similar signatures.
gate.before_followup: Another agent reviews the final operation rules, candidate constraints, naming branches/pair roster and primary quantity before root explicitly authorizes F coding. This is internal execution control already required by the goal, not another user authorization request.
gate.all_six_before_scores: Finish and freeze allsix observability packets before computing H; retain not_reviewed and reviewed_unresolved separately. A defined unit with unknown signature is still retained; a genuinely undefined unit is not replaced by a smaller favorable sample.
gate.proposed_procedural_calibration_gate: Proposal for root to approve before scoring: allsix units defined under unchanged granularity, nonempty joint domains, no input conflicts, BOTH conditional primary H and prespecified matched-four H4 have rigorously positive lower bounds over the SAME retained joint allowed domain, and independent numerical replay agreement. Report their coupled attainable set or joint witnesses and H-H4 decomposition; separate marginal positive minima over the same domain suffice for uniform positivity, but one cannot combine endpoint values from different completions as one observation. This prevents isolated F01 difference alone from qualifying the procedure; neither quantity rescues the other. Strict literal-name branch is already undefined and remains a limitation; it cannot pass visual-only/unconditional calibration. Positive conditional H/H4 support only conditional procedural continuation. Root must explicitly decide whether that conditional name evidence is sufficient under the goal before authorizing any Voynich coding; this text does not authorize it. Failure or sign-indeterminate bounds for either stops return-to-Voynich scoring.
gate.return_to_nine: Even if gate passes, require the same frozen operation rules to support allnine original loci and canonical-sharing/candidate contracts. If any scope fails, report allnine deficits and do not choose a subset or modify thresholds.

diagnostics.purpose_and_limit: The full local incidence record preserves carrier-zone-child relations and ambiguous ownership that the old four binary features omit. Its capped four-coordinate score is deliberately lossy and is NOT established to be more discriminating. Ease of annotation is not evidence of validity. This proposal can fail as a comparative instrument even when its records are useful.
diagnostics.Q0_saturation: If each of the old K01-K04 terminal witnesses also meets the NEW local no-child and distinct carrier-zone conditions, old lower counts6/6/2/4 imply Q0=2 for allfour. The old counts alone do not establish those new conditions. A constant Q0 contributes exactly0 to H because its distance is0 for every pair; the fixed divisor8 remains and cannot be renormalized after inspection. Thus this coordinate may merely repeat a coarse baseline.
diagnostics.Q1_degree_two_degeneracy: A channel continuing through a degree-two point has no intrinsic carrier/child distinction. Colour or width changes do not rescue Q1. Only a separately delimited cap/attachment region with a visibly distinct outgoing port supports this motif; otherwise merge the uniform trace or retain unresolved alternatives. If every purported Q1 reduces to arbitrary subdivision, Q1 has no admissible positive witnesses and the proposed relation is operationally inadequate. Do not insert new cuts to populate the coordinate.
diagnostics.retained_relation: Q2 distinguishes a carrier ending at a locally bounded zone bearing >=2 directly witnessed free-ending channels from a bare cap. QJ distinguishes an actual local three-arm continuous junction from an opaque body carrying multiple ports. These are incidence/attachment facts, not organ guesses; each still requires witnesses. Different Q2/QJ classifications may describe shared material and are not independent evidence.
counterexamples: EntryU with2 bare caps and EntryV with20 bare caps, no other motifs: both[2,0,0,0], S=1 although raw counts differ tenfold.
EntryU with2 qualifying two-child zones and EntryV with8 qualifying many-child zones, same capped joins and other classes: identical four-vector despite different branching degree and distribution.

Moving identical witnessed motifs among different opaque bodies, or changing their order along a larger structure while preserving four capped totals, can leave S=1. Containment beyond the local relation, global topology and spatial layout are not recovered.

Adding a degree-two marked point on a continuous unbranched path cannot legitimately create Q1. If accepted, the score would measure annotator subdivision rather than drawing relation; such a candidate must be rejected.
diagnostics.algebra: For one mixed stratum, H=(mean_different d - mean_same d)/8 with d=sum_k|z_ik-z_jk|. A fixed constant coordinate cancels exactly; four identical fixed signatures make every S=1 and H=0. If the joint admissible domains contain a single common signature for all compared entries, the all-equal assignment witnesses H=0 and hence no strictly positive robust lower bound is possible. A constant pair-similarity matrix also yields H=0. Shared absence raises raw S but does not by itself yield a positive H.
diagnostics.required_pre_score_diagnostic: After each observation packet freezes, report per-entry domains, each coordinate range, universally constant coordinates, overlap/common-signature feasibility and explicit retained/discarded relations. First diagnose K development without K name contrast. On F apply the same diagnostics before interpreting H; no changed cap, omitted coordinate, adaptive denominator or favorable subset. Do not describe saturation alone as successful hierarchy discrimination.
diagnostics.failure_interpretation: An uninformative or sign-indeterminate H is an instrument limit for this frozen sample. The full relation table can remain useful descriptive evidence, but a successful local annotation exercise does not establish comparative calibration.

execution_addendum_text:
第五轮：K试记执行补充 v1

本补充落实method_review_v1的B01–B03/N02，不改变method_proposal_v1的四维、饱和阈值、S/H/H4、名称分支或门槛。它在任何新K编码前冻结；不是试记后那一次允许的开发修订。F编码、实际评分及返回伏尼契均未批准。

估计对象是固定原图中符合定义的纸面可见结构。检查清楚且均匀的不透明内区，没有可分线条时不因想象的内部路线增加未知量；外边界的端口须另查。尚未查看、模糊、损伤、叠压导致是否存在合格可见痕迹未定，才按实际影响的类别保留余项。

每个载体C—端区Z保留可见分界、入端口、可能出端口、路径和两处横截边界坐标（或明确单笔线依据）。Q0需相关周界/附着区对合格T的局部排除，Q1需一条合格T及对第二条的排除。到另一J/B的非T出线另记，Q0不一定等于裸端。颜色/宽度变化与任意切口均不足以创造Z。未知分类列全部可支持的备选，不因饱和而跳过局部证据。旧末端6/6/2/4不直接搬作新Q0。

有限完整case记录
公开observation_v1.json使用schema local_hierarchy_cases_v1，entries固定K01–K04，cross_entry_constraints记录实际是否存在跨条目实体/解释约束。每行保留原图URL/SHA/尺寸、原整条目范围、实际查看回执、单位是否定义、覆盖、未决范围与最小补证。
units为规范单元ID到记录的映射：carrier_id、zone_id、allowed_classes（Q0/Q1/Q2）、坐标/关系/局部排除证据、备选理由。joins为可见连接ID到三臂见证记录的映射。不能把同一端帽重命名两次增加数量。
cases为所有保留完整解释的列表。每case包含id、unit_classes（ID到Q0/Q1/Q2）、join_ids、所选别名/归属/共享尾段/互斥解释及证据引用；未选或不合格的候选须说明去向。at_most_one列已知最多同时成立一个的ID组及原因。
每case的residual包含vectors（按Q0/Q1/Q2/QJ排列的四个0/1/2整数、2代表至少2的饱和增量）、coverage_refs、disjoint_from_counted_witnesses:true、理由、放宽标志。每个非零可能增量必须由特定未决/未查范围支持；可能与已计痕迹别名或共享尾段的候选必须放入case约束，不得再作为独立余项。
residual只放宽明确未决的剩余；其四维乘积若使用须显式标记ALLOWED_SUPERSET，不称几何可行全集。确定没有新增时也显式列[[0,0,0,0]]并给覆盖依据。计数脚本从完整case的去重ID生成base，逐个加extra并min(2,base+extra)，全case取并；保留signature的case_id+extra_index原像。不手填最终签名、不挑有利case。记录无法穷尽时如实保留缺口，不假装只有所列case。
unit_defined=false则域为null；单位已定义但特征未知与之不同。空case/空允许域是输入冲突，不填0。

执行范围与时间
K01→K02→K03→K04固定顺序，同一规则、原整条目范围。可复用旧官方JPEG和私有整数裁视口；每例最多三个新增同图整数裁区（PNG、原像素），不下载新页、不增强/缩放测量/补笔/旋转，不公开私有图。裁区生成和实际查看分别登记。所有四行必须保留，未看与看后未定分开。来源可用官方URL与哈希公开，私有文件路径另存output，不进入公开数据。
总上限60分钟：每例最多12分钟，最后12分钟整理。计时包括查看、裁区与登记，不要求耗满；未完成部分如实标记。根批准时间加60分钟为本次截止，且不得越过本轮总体停止长实验时间。超过时限不得为凑完整而补做未记录观察。

开发决策与基线
试记后只计算签名域、常量维、公共向量与信息损失诊断，不计算K同名对比分选择版本。若需要，可作最多一次明确开发修订，保留失败并统一用于全四K；不能反复改阈值。F前统一冻结最终合同，全六先留可观察性记录后才考虑真实评分。
旧G1–G4基线仅指K四例16格/C的历史失败与开发动机；九位置48格/T/D99保持。不同F样本的H不与旧K的C比较方法优劣，本轮不额外新增F的G编码。
当前两个求界实现要求跨entry允许域为笛卡尔积；共用稿本/数字源不是共享实体。若实际存在跨entry实体或解释约束，F入口须拒绝未处理约束，改用完整外层case后条件求界或报告未完成。保守域极值、图形可实现性和历史/名称真值三者分开。

本补充支持根既有授权下的一次K试记，不新增用户审批，不认定方法有效。坐标与别名记录仅可追溯，不是专家认证或精密误差界。未知和负结果同样交付。

第五个最多七小时研究目标：2026-11-19T10:47:18.000Z–2026-11-19T17:47:18.000Z。延续用户“完成目标就直接设置下一目标”的授权，完整交付后可提前结束，保留计划与实际时间，不以空等待凑时长。主方向：先在已知历史名称的图像条目上建立可复核的局部部件层级表示，检验测量是否有区分力，再决定能否返回伏尼契标签，而不是直接猜植物名。
继承第四窗口全部冻结结果与失败：九位置、12候选组、16联合归属、48格及T/C/D99不改；已曝光四例K01–K04仅作开发。读取measurement_development_v1的全部局部见证与审查，针对载体—端区—细通道层级、不可分宽体、可见端口、共享或互斥候选，制定一套语义中立的记录定义；不能画出不可见内部连接，不能把人工8像素容差当测量误差界。先明确完整覆盖、局部下界、未知上界、未查看与看后未定的区别，由另一代理在新编码/评分前审查并冻结合同。最多一轮明确开发修订，保留原失败，不反复改阈值追正结果。
固定第四窗口六个后续候选F01–F06为后续记录范围，全六保留；它们未用于新方法开发但图像/名称已曝光，不称盲测试集。先分列原字形、拉丁缩写展开、官方目录名、图像清晰度和整条目范围。mentastrum、marrubium的目录条件与ruta限定词缺口不能抹平；不得截取前缀、改名或替换失败例来凑配对。确需更清晰图时，每个相关馆藏位置只做一次有界官方入口查找，使用实际出现的链接，保留访问失败和旧低清证据，不猜端点数组或换图。私有馆藏图不导出。
在查看六例的新图形得分之前，冻结全部可定义同名/异名对、命名资格分支、来源依赖、测量粒度、主描述量及未知/候选联合处理。所有六例先完成可观察性记录再决定按既定门槛计算；不合格项如实保留并说明对分母的影响，差不可定义时不得填0。旧G1–G4仅作明确基线，不能覆盖旧矩阵。任何计算须有另一实现复算关键分母、共享变量与完整结果；数值一致不是专家认证。不能用两组小样本的正结果估计普遍准确率或宣称名称识别成功。
只有事先固定的已知名称校准门槛实际满足、且新方法支持原伏尼契全九范围时，才把同一冻结方法返回全九；不能选择较容易的子集。若校准或可观察性失败，交付所有固定条目的具体失败、可运行记录与所需最小新证据，并停止本轮伏尼契新评分。这一有条件分支不要求强行产生正结果或译文。
可并行使用2–3个子代理处理方案/图像记录/独立计算或直接文献，但如实披露同AI、知情观察与共同稿本传统；不重复复看充当独立历史证据。原图只允许可追溯整数裁视口或明确副本，不用生成模型补字补图，不改原图或既有冻结结果。查必要的直接先例并注明实际阅读范围，不声称世界首次。
在原GitHub仓库与Pages发布计划、名称与图像资格、全部记录、结果/失败、可复算入口及可视化；逐项验收后才结题。计划截止前45分钟不启动长实验，至少预留30分钟发布验收；若提前完成全部实质交付可依用户授权提前收束，准确记录实际用时。

metric_information_loss_text:
固定四维签名的信息损失：人工全二叉树条件分析 v1

范围
仅分析人为指定的理想模型：外部B经C到根；每个树节点有可分的入C与可见Z；叶是自由端，内部节点恰有两个孩子并形成可见J；直接T只指该节点的叶孩子。所有角色完全可见，不含歧义或未观察区域。
这不是说手稿拥有完整树，也不把二叉假设套到实际记录。本任务未读取F目录、未看图、未算K名称分数。F观察规则和指标均不改；以下结果不能预判实际F的签名或对比符号。

条件推导
设L为叶数，I为内部节点数，a_r为恰有r个叶孩子的内部节点数（r=0,1,2）。
每个叶节点自己的Z无出线，计入Q0；内部节点若没有叶孩子，也没有合格直接T，仍计入Q0，即使它有两条通向其他J的出线。因此：
Q0=L+a_0，Q1=a_1，Q2=a_2，QJ=I；最后各维min(2,Q)。
这里Q0不等于“裸端数量”，它还包含有出线但无合格T的内部节点。
内部节点的叶孩子作为T，与该孩子自身的入C可以是同一物理通道；公式数的是不同局部关系，没有制造第二条通道。

对至少有一个内部节点的全二叉树，L=I+1，I=a_0+a_1+a_2，L=a_1+2a_2。
故a_2=a_0+1，I=2a_0+a_1+1，原始四元组为：
(3a_0+a_1+2，a_1，a_0+1，2a_0+a_1+1)。
所以所有非平凡此类树Q0都饱和为2；在此理想类上，最终签名只剩最多六种，而不是所有81种均可由这种树实现。
单叶树是独立边界例：(1,0,0,0)，不适用“每个叶都有内部父亲”的L=a_1+2a_2关系。

三族明确碰撞
1. 完美平衡树：根到叶边数h≥2。
L=2^h，I=2^h−1，a_0=2^(h−1)−1，a_1=0，a_2=2^(h−1)。
原始四元组=(3·2^(h−1)−1，0，2^(h−1)，2^h−1)，签名恒为(2,0,2,2)。
人工h=2/3/4的原始值分别(5,0,2,3)、(11,0,4,7)、(23,0,8,15)。大小、深度不断增加，固定签名不变。

2. 单链梳状树：m≥3个内部节点；除底端一对叶外，每个内部节点有一个叶孩子和一个内部孩子。
L=m+1，I=m，a_0=0，a_1=m−1，a_2=1。
原始值=(m+1,m−1,1,m)，签名恒为(2,2,1,2)。
人工m=3/4/6的原始值分别(4,2,1,3)、(5,3,1,4)、(7,5,1,6)；高度分别3/4/6仍不能区分。

3. 根接两条梳状子树：两条各有p,q≥1个内部节点，且p+q≥4。
L=p+q+2，I=p+q+1，a_0=1，a_1=p+q−2，a_2=2。
原始值=(p+q+3,p+q−2,2,p+q+1)，签名恒为(2,2,2,2)。
人工(p,q)=(1,3)与(2,2)都有原始值(7,2,2,5)，但高度分别4与3，无序树形也不同。
这显示即使不饱和，局部类型总数仍遗失分配位置和全局结构；不是只有阈值2导致的信息损失。
(p,q)=(2,4)原始值(9,4,2,7)、高度5，也落在同一签名，另体现规模损失。

解释边界
三族内部相互碰撞，不是说三个族的签名彼此一样。此签名仍能区分上列三种局部计数类型；它不能恢复准确规模、高度、分支的不均衡程度或相同局部关系分布在树中何处。
固定签名的相等只表示这四项饱和量相等，不保证完整树相同；实际方法本来也不要求完整树。该局限是预先披露的解释边界，不能据此改阈值、换指标或选有利的F子集。

逐节点直接计数与独立结构统计推导相符；三族碰撞成立；同原始计数但不同无序树形/高度的反例通过。
